name: Algebraic Discriminant Obfuscation
description: Replaces a geometric or direct inequality constraint with a requirement that a dynamically constructed polynomial has no real roots. The discriminant of the polynomial is engineered to factor into an expression that is strictly negative if and only if the original inequality holds. This prevents naive precomputation or simple pattern matching, forcing the model to either algebraically deduce the underlying constraint to apply domain-specific optimizations (like graph adjacency lists) or suffer Time Limit Exceeded from expensive unoptimized dynamic checks.
